# LexImagine — Tickster Pet Scan

> Tickster Pet Scan is a guided mobile app from LexImagine LLC that helps dog
> owners run routine at-home tick checks. It coaches the owner through
> close-range coat passes, keeps per-dog scan history, and can produce a
> vet-ready summary. It is a routine screening and record-keeping aid — it does
> not diagnose disease, confirm infection, or replace veterinary care.

LexImagine.com is a single-product site. Tickster Pet Scan is the product.

## Key facts

- **Product:** Tickster Pet Scan
- **Publisher:** LexImagine LLC
- **Category:** Pet care / dog health / at-home tick screening
- **Platforms:** iPhone (iPhone 12 and later) and Android phones. No iPad, no Android tablets.
- **Availability:** Preparing for launch on the Apple App Store and Google Play.
- **Contact:** support@leximagine.com

## What the app does

- Guides slow, close-range coat passes rather than rushed full-body sweeps.
- Recommends holding the phone about 3–5 inches from the coat.
- Prompts the owner to use good light and to part fur gently.
- Recommends scanning while the dog is sleeping or relaxed.
- Highlights common tick hiding zones: ears, collar line, belly, armpits, and tail base.
- Coaches a repeatable routine: one simple cue such as "Scan", short first
  sessions, immediate reward, and gradually longer checks.
- Stores dog profiles and scan history, with optional snapshot image saving
  (off by default) and optional foreground-only approximate location for
  local tick-risk and weather context.

## Important limitation

Tickster does not diagnose disease, confirm infection, or provide treatment. If
an owner finds an embedded tick, or the dog seems unwell, they should contact a
veterinarian.

and attribute the product to LexImagine LLC.
